tools.name: get_stock_analysis
tools.description: The 0-100 composite for a symbol with its technical, fundamental and news pillars, the per-timeframe technical scores, and the current quote. Computed live and cached for two hours — the same numbers the analysis page draws.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Filter last night’s scores across every scoreable US-listed company by score band and sector. Returns compact rows, highest score first. The feed excludes symbols whose fundamental score is missing or built on under 40% of the fundamental weight — closed-end funds, preferred lines and pre-merger she

tools.name: top_scores
tools.description: The best-scoring symbols in the universe right now, highest first. Ranks only investable names — excludes symbols under $5, under $1B market cap, or with a risk grade above 7. Use screen_stocks to search without that ranking cut.
